mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate slower economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE spikes and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 declines and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised upwards.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between RSAFS increases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% year-over-year, it signals inflationary pressure and potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between HOUST declines and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
